subject: Re: Aligning Clearwell site visit demo around travel — proposed change
messages:
From: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@clearwelldx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alan Ruiz <alan.ruiz@clearwelldx.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clearwell week of 11/8 — travel conflict and suggestion

Hi Priya,

Quick heads-up — our field team will be on a multi-site run the week of 11/8 and the original onsite demo window you provided overlaps with client visits in Seattle and Portland. Logistically we can't host the full 90-minute walkthrough on the 9th as planned.

Two options from our side that would help:
- Condense to a 20–30 minute executive briefing on Tues 11/9 in the morning (Alan and I can join) and then schedule a separate technical hands-on lab (remote) the following week when our engineers are back.
- Keep a 60-minute onsite on 11/16 when the team is regrouped — if you have availability then.

Either works; we want to make sure Alan (decision lead) sees the executive summary before the board meeting later that week. Can you confirm availability or propose an alternative?

Attached: Clearwell_travel_itinerary.pdf (high-level)

Thanks — Olivia

Olivia Martin
Director, Field Operations
Clearwell Diagnostics
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@clearwelldx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clearwell week of 11/8 — travel conflict and suggestion

Hi Olivia — super helpful context, thanks for the itinerary.

We can absolutely adapt. Quick response:
- Marcus (AE) can run a focused 20–25 minute executive briefing on Tue 11/9 between 09:00–11:30 PT. He'll cover outcomes, cost/latency profile, and how Redwood fits your operational constraints.
- For the technical hands-on lab, Mina (CS/SE) proposes Wed 11/17 or Thu 11/18 for a 60–75 minute remote session with your engineers — we can provision a short test tenant for them to run queries live.

I've attached a short proposed-demo-agenda.docx with the two-slot approach (exec brief + tech lab). If you prefer the single onsite on 11/16, Marcus can check that slot as well but he's tight that week; please let us know preference and Alan's availability.

Available exec windows on our side (PT):
- Tue 11/9: 09:00–10:30, 11:00–11:30
- Wed 11/10: 08:30–09:00 (short check-in)

If you confirm Tue 11/9 morning by EOD we'll lock Marcus and send a calendar invite with a 20-minute agenda.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cal: https://calendly.com/priya-redwood/20min
From: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@clearwelldx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alan Ruiz <alan.ruiz@clearwelldx.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clearwell week of 11/8 — travel conflict and suggestion

Priya — thanks, the plan reads well. A couple of details from our side:
- Alan's only open window before his board meeting is Tue 11/9 11:00–11:30 PT (short but sufficient for the exec summary).
- Our engineering lead prefers the remote hands-on to be on 11/17 since the team returns that day. 60 minutes is perfect.

We'd like the exec briefing to be concise: 15–20 minutes, with a single slide that highlights operational impacts and the decision ask. Marcus, if you can keep it tight and call out the recommended guardrails (batching, quantization profile), that would be ideal.

Attaching our itinerary for context (same file). Alan will not be on the hands-on call.

Thanks, Olivia

Action items:
